gold_source: Companion to urgency-case1-nl. Not yet piloted.

metadata.description: Ground truth priority is unchanged from urgency-case1-nl (task_1 is genuinely more urgent), but the AMP rendering carries no marker distinguishing the two requests' urgency. This tests whether the missing information leads to a wrong or arbitrary choice, not just a lower self-reported confidence.
metadata.expected_failure_mode: Arbitrary choice (order of receipt, task_2's more 'active'-sounding lemma, or an explicit refusal to prioritize) instead of the ground-truth-correct task_1.
